84b0d2c225eca2aee2b120e5def2669cfc232e8c.sourceText: 超声波传感器是将超声波信号转换成其它能量信号（通常是电信号）的传感器。超声波是[振动频率](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%8C%AF%E5%8A%A8%E9%A2%91%E7%8E%87/8068137)高于20kHz的机械波。它具有频率高、波长短、绕射现象小，特别是方向性好、能够成为[射线](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%B0%84%E7%BA%BF/327964)而定向传播等特点。超声波对液体、固体的穿透本领很大，尤其是在阳光不透明的固体中。超声波碰到杂质或分界面会产生显著反射形成反射回波，碰到活动物体能产生[多普勒效应](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%A4%9A%E6%99%AE%E5%8B%92%E6%95%88%E5%BA%94/115710)。超声波传感器广泛应用在工业、国防、生物医学等方面。
84b0d2c225eca2aee2b120e5def2669cfc232e8c.translatedText: An ultrasonic sensor is a sensor that converts ultrasonic signals into other energy signals (usually electrical signals)\. Ultrasound is a mechanical wave with a[vibration frequency](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E6%8C%AF%E5%8A%A8%E9%A2%91%E7%8E%87/8068137)higher than 20 kHz\. It has the characteristics of high frequency, short wavelength, small diffraction phenomenon, and in particular, good directivity, and can become[rays](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%B0%84%E7%BA%BF/327964)and propagate directionally\. Ultrasound has a strong penetrating ability into liquids and solids, especially in solids that are opaque to sunlight\. When ultrasound encounters impurities or interfaces, it produces significant reflection to form reflected echoes, and when it encounters moving objects, it can produce the[Doppler effect](https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%A4%9A%E6%99%AE%E5%8B%92%E6%95%88%E5%BA%94/115710)\. Ultrasonic sensors are widely used in industry, national defense, biomedicine, and other fields\.

The decay timing uses the input point cloud timestamp, not the computer wall clock; this block does not list `use_sim_time`, nor can it be used to prove that the full\-chain clock or the intra\-point time unit is already correct\.
